items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Sam. Oh, there's a fine team right there.

ctx.x: I left Sharky in 1950, you understand? Yeah, yeah. Bobby Blank. I remember him.
Sam. Oh, there's a fine team right there.
Edith Fellas. Do you remember her? No, I don't. I don't remember Tommy Diggs either.
